sources.title: Revisiting Group Relative Policy Optimization:Insights into On-Policy ...
sources.snippet: Abstract. We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in both on-policy and off-policy optimization regimes. Our motivation comes from recent work on off-policy Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which improves training stability, sampling efficiency, and memory usage. sources.title: LLM Fine-tuning with GRPO | AgileRL/AgileRL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: GRPO is a policy gradient algorithm specifically designed for fine-tuning Large Language Models. It extends the LLMAlgorithm base class and implements a PPO-style approach with group-based advantage calculation and KL divergence regularization against a reference model.
